sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

As a growing supplier, we are very eager to build a strong partnership with your company and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your manufacturing needs. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We remain at your full disposal should you have any questions or require any further information, and we look forward to the prospect of working together.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.body: Thank you for your offer. We need a better price to go ahead.

move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.
To be fully transparent with you:
We appreciate your feedback and are keen to move forward with this project.
To support your cost targets, we can offer a revised price of €15.50 per unit, provided we maintain our standard 45-day lead time.
This represents a significant concession on our part while ensuring we can meet your requirements reliably.
Our whole team is ready, and we will do everything to make you a satisfied customer.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: SH-220 – counter-offer and term sheets for award
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for offer:DEMO-C1-1 at €16.40 with 35-day delivery. We appreciate the €15.50 alternative , but its 45-day lead time exceeds the 42-day maximum our schedule permits.
We would like to move toward an award and need a sharper package; please see the term sheets below. Longer payment terms reduce our financing cost and let us commit to a stable volume with confidence. Could you also provide a brief cost breakdown and confirm your earliest firm delivery date?
We look forward to your reply.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.
To be fully transparent with you:
The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We appreciate your feedback and are pleased to offer a revised price of €16.10 for the 35-day lead time and 45-day payment terms.
Our colleagues will provide the requested cost breakdown and confirm the earliest firm delivery date shortly.
While we cannot accommodate 60-day payment terms, we are fully committed to supporting your schedule and volume requirements.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
